column1: 4.5.17 Uninterrupted Power Supplies-1&2 (UPS-1 & UPS-2). Uninterrupted Power
Supply (UPS-1) has inbuilt battery to provide online backup power for processor units
used in SCD Rack. The mounting arrangement & foundations shall be prepared as per
binding data. Uninterrupted Power Supply (UPS-1) is a part of installation materials.
